description: MAIN-PARA's first-entry path at app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl:87-90 driven by a REGULAR USER, which is the whole point of the case: it is the user-type counterpart of the administrator taking the identical path in case20, and the ten composed option lines, the low-values fields, the flags, the colour byte, the mapset and the map here are byte-identical to the ones that case pins - so the first paint is proved user-type independent rather than merely asserted to be. CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives 0, satisfying 88 CDEMO-PGM-ENTER at app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:30, so IF NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER at line 87 holds: line 88 flips the context to 1, line 89 MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COMEN1AO clears every output field - which is why OPTN011O, OPTN012O and OPTIONO come back as X'00' at their declared widths and not as spaces - and line 90 paints. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY is NOT performed, so the authorisation filter at lines 136-143 never evaluates at all on this branch, even for a CDEMO-USRTYP-USER caller, and RECEIVE-MENU-SCREEN does not run either: no OPTIONI is ever received, which is why mapFields declares none rather than declaring a value the program could not have read. The AID is declared because a terminal always presents one, though line 93 is never reached to compare it. BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS at 236-277 contains no user-type logic whatsoever: it runs PERFORM VARYING WS-IDX FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-IDX > CDEMO-MENU-OPT-COUNT, which app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy:21 values at 10, and composes each line from CDEMO-MENU-OPT-NUM DELIMITED BY SIZE, then '. ', then all thirty-five bytes of CDEMO-MENU-OPT-NAME - also DELIMITED BY SIZE, unlike line 161 - for thirty-nine characters into the PIC X(40) that line 241 has just cleared, leaving character 40 a space. Nothing is filtered out of a regular user's menu, and that would stay true even on the paths where the filter does run, because all ten valued CDEMO-MENU-OPT-USRTYPE columns of app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy carry 'U' - lines 29, 35, 41, 47, 53, 59, 65, 72, 78 and 84 - so the comparison against 'A' at line 137 cannot be true for any populated subscript and the No access - Admin Only option... text is unreachable from the shipped table, which is why case11 has to supply a stub table to reach it. That is recorded rather than corrected, and so is line 69 of the same copybook, which preserves a commented-out 'Transaction Add (Admin Only)       ' name for option 8 while the active line 70 reads 'Transaction Add                    ' with 'U' at line 72: documentary evidence that option 8 was once meant to be admin-only, and acting on it would be a behaviour change. Slots 11 and 12 exist because CDEMO-MENU-OPT is OCCURS 12 TIMES at :88 while the count is 10, so the EVALUATE WS-IDX arms WHEN 11, WHEN 12 and WHEN OTHER at 269-274 are unreachable preserved dead code and those two lines stay exactly as line 89 left them - gate G33 from the unwritten end, with subscript 1 pinned as the FIRST entry at the other. ERRMSGC is DFHRED because that is the colour the map itself declares, COLOR=RED at app/bms/COMEN01.bms:154-157, and emphatically not because any field was highlighted: COMEN01C does not copy CSSETATY - its COPY list at lines 50-61 is COCOM01Y, COMEN02Y, COMEN01, COTTL01Y, CSDAT01Y, CSMSG01Y, CSUSR01Y, DFHAID and DFHBMSCA - so the DFHRED-plus-asterisk highlight that gate G38 is usually phrased around has no subject in this program, and G38 is honoured instead by the ENTER and REENTER split, of which this case is the ENTER side. The program's one and only attribute write is the MOVE DFHGREEN TO ERRMSGC of line 158, on the coming-soon path this case never reaches, so the byte here is the untouched map default. The message is the eighty-byte WS-MESSAGE of line 38, all spaces since line 79, carried on the WS_MESSAGE_80 channel: the seventy-eight-byte ERRMSGO that app/cpy-bms/COMEN01.CPY:138 declares is line 187's work and belongs to the controller, which is case16's subject, and no thank-you text belongs on any path at all - COTTL01Y's CCDA-THANK-YOU and CSMSG01Y's CCDA-MSG-THANK-YOU are both copied in and neither is ever referenced. nextProgram is omitted because no XCTL happens here, while nextMapset and nextMap are named from lines 190-191 and app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:133 and :399-400. The unit is admin.MainMenuService called as a plain object with no MockMvc, no HTTP and no JobLauncher in the path, which is gate G51, and the whole conversation - the communication area, the AID and the screen values - travels in the payload rather than in server-side session state, which is gate G37. CDEMO-FROM-TRANID and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM arrive from COSGN00C's XCTL and are carried through untouched, because lines 147-148 sit inside the unreached PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; CDEMO-USER-TYPE is carried through unaltered too, and line 150's MOVE SEC-USR-TYPE TO CDEMO-USER-TYPE is commented out, so user type is inbound only and is never looked up in USRSEC, re-verified or hashed. inputs, expectedWrites and expectedFinalState are all empty because COMEN01C performs no dataset access whatsoever - it declares WS-USRSEC-FILE at line 39 and copies CSUSR01Y at line 58, and the migration's dataset usage map groups the program under USRSEC, but there is no SELECT, no FD and no file operand anywhere in its 282 lines. case18 takes this same path with the security file seeded and must produce this same paint, so the two are a control and an experiment: identical output with the dataset absent and present is what turns the absence into a positive assertion rather than an omission. The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:33, the timestamp COMEN01C's own version footer at line 281 carries, so the instant is anchored in the source rather than chosen, and every case in this directory pins that same instant and names US-ASCII explicitly instead of leaving a code page to a platform default; POPULATE-HEADER-INFO reads FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE at line 214 and is the controller's work, so no header field is pinned here. Every expected value above is statically derived - read out of the COBOL paragraph that produces it and cross-checked against the literals of app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy, the sixteen fields and 88-levels of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COMEN01.CPY and the DFHMDF definitions of app/bms/COMEN01.bms - and not one expectation was captured from an execution of the legacy program, which is empirically impossible in this environment: no z/OS and no CICS emulator, an indexed file handler the available compiler reports as disabled, no Language Environment CEE services, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR absent from the repository altogether. That substitution is escalated rather than absorbed - risk R-A - and the gate this case answers to is unchanged: G18 requires its diff count to be zero, field by field.
